asha: Quick sync — we need to lock acceptance criteria for the Observability workstream this quarter. Main tradeoffs are retention cost vs fidelity, and dashboard scope vs trace + error-analysis. Who has force-ranked customer asks?

ben: I can pull infra numbers. short version: 30d raw traces for all customers jumps egress/cold-store by ~3x. Aggregated metrics + sampled traces is closer to 1.2x.

priya: SLO perspective: we need traces for 95th+ latency spike debugging. Sampling loses the tail unless we tag by anomaly signals.

asha: @ben can you paste the rough cost delta here? need it to justify to GTM/Finance. also want to propose launch gate: "observability-minimum" = dashboards + 14d traces (sampled smartly) + error-grouping + customer-facing retention toggle.

ben: Cost delta quick numbers (very rough):
```
- 7d raw traces: baseline
- 14d sampled traces + aggregated metrics: +95% infra cost
- 30d raw traces for all users: +320% infra cost
```
(assumes current ingest + S3-like cold storage pricing)

elena: From Support: customers asking for 30d crash traces and richer error context (stack + user event snapshot). Top-5 enterprise deals asked specifically. If we ship 14d only, we need an upsell/paid retention option.

marcus: For dashboards, we should surface high-level UX that answers the "why did latency go up" question in <2 clicks. That needs attribution views (by model, route, region) and automatic anomaly markers. Backend cost for these aggregations is modest — mostly storage + pre-aggregation jobs.

asha: Proposed prioritized checklist for the quarter (MVP -> Stretch):
1) Dashboards: latency/throughput/cost per-route, anomalies, attribution (MVP)
2) Error grouping + user event snapshot (MVP for enterprise customers only)
3) Tracing: 14d sampled w/ anomaly-tagged retention (MVP), 30d raw as paid add-on (Stretch)
4) Retention toggle in Console + billing flagging (MVP)
5) Eval hooks: regression tests on quality when sampling/quantization changes (MVP)

priya: Agree but adding: must include a canary that verifies tail-case capture — define a small probe workload that intentionally creates tail latencies to ensure sampling keeps those traces.

ben: Implementation notes: sampling strategy = baseline random + rule-based retention when error-rate > threshold OR latency > P95 baseline. We'll need a config surface in Console for rules.

asha: Launch criteria suggestion (must pass all):
- Dashboards: key KPIs present + drilldowns work end-to-end
- Traces: sampling strategy live and can be toggled per-customer
- Error analysis: grouping + snapshot available for enterprise orgs
- Cost guardrail: rollout gated by infra autoscaling tests + finance signoff at <x% projected cost increase
- E2E regression tests for quality via eval harness

elena: Can we make the enterprise error snapshot gated to only orgs with contract flag? That reduces storage blast radius.

asha: yes, flagging for enterprise-only for detailed snapshots. public tiers get summarized context.

marcus: Request: product needs to own a lightweight query-pattern budget — define max ad-hoc dashboard query window for free tier (e.g., 7d) to avoid runaway costs.

priya: Ops ask: retention config defaults must be safe. set default to 14d sampled + 7d raw-on-demand for all new orgs.

ben: I'll prototype a dashboard showing cost delta per retention profile and a Console mock of the retention toggle by next Wed.

asha: Great. Next steps: Ben prototype + cost graph, Priya define canary probe + SLO test, Marcus wireframe attribution UX, Elena compile top-5 enterprise asks into one doc. We'll reconvene Thu 10am PT. If anyone can't make it, drop notes here. :calendar: :rocket:

console-bot: Reminder: Thu sync created — #product 2026-03-26 10:00 PT.

elena: I'll share customer quotes in the doc before Thu.

ben: Added a quick mock link: https://figma.redwood/mock/obs-cost-toggle (WIP)

asha: perfect, thanks all.
